subject: integration
name: Load from public IPFS gateways
summary: Loads a name's IPFS record through three public gateways by default (ipfs.orbitor.dev, ipfs.filebase.io, trustless-gateway.link), asking the person first for each load. Blocks are checked against their CID and IPNS records against their signature, so a gateway cannot change a block. It relies on those servers: if they stop or say not found, nothing loads, and each sees the IP address and every CID asked. A DNSLink is read over unauthenticated DNS, and an IPNS record may be older than the newest. Level 3, not 4. Judged here by its publisher.
